ROOT="$(dirname "$(dirname "$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$0")")")")"

APP_NAME="@@APPNAME@@"
VERSION="@@VERSION@@"
COMMIT="@@COMMIT@@"
EXEC_NAME="@@APPNAME@@"
CLI_SCRIPT="$ROOT/out/server-cli.js"
"$ROOT/node" "$CLI_SCRIPT" "$APP_NAME" "$VERSION" "$COMMIT" "$EXEC_NAME" "--openExternal" "$@"
